semanticBoundary: The base has login and account-creation screens but no reading-history-driven encouragement, impression preferences, defer/repeat lifecycle, permanent dismissal, or external-link suppression for this feature.

facts: A permanent logged-in account is rejected before reading-history eligibility is evaluated, while a temporary account may continue.
The first impression requires two distinct qualifying reading days, with a 14-day span bound, a 7-day minimum age for the earlier day, and a 365-day history cutoff.
After one impression, at least two distinct reading days after the persisted impression date are required.
An invalid persisted date returns false rather than throwing or creating another impression.
Constructing the screen ViewModel increments the impression count, stores the current date, and loads personalized counts from production DAOs.
The close control writes the terminal impression value before finishing.
Maybe later finishes without overwriting the ordinary impression count.
Create account launches the registration-first LoginActivity with the encouragement source.
A successful login result finishes the encouragement activity.
Initial onboarding and higher-priority Reading Challenge and Year in Review flows run before account encouragement.
A PageActivity launched by ACTION_VIEW with a non-null URI is recognized as an external article link and does not start the encouragement.
Ordinary eligible launches start CreateAccountEncourageActivity through the real application routing path.
The Compose surface presents personalized account-benefit cards and distinct close, create-account, and Maybe later actions.
Eligibility is derived from persisted distinct reading days and recent history rather than an evaluator-supplied boolean.
The impression count and last-impression date use the production preference store and survive activity and application recreation.
Exercises first eligibility boundaries with persisted HistoryEntry rows.
Verifies permanent-account suppression and temporary-account eligibility.
Verifies one-day deferral, invalid persisted date handling, the second impression, two-impression cap, and permanent close behavior through Android runtime UI.
finalTests.coverageGap: The upstream test does not complete the real registration result or explicitly launch an external article deep link; those transitions require evaluator-owned runtime coverage through the production activity-result and routing paths.
